title: Simple checker fix outcome benchmark
task_prompt: Make a narrow checker or hook fix without expanding governance scope.

expected_checks.rationale: Harness code should stay within code-shape budget.

notes: Measures whether a small harness task can finish cleanly without overreach.

title: Cross-file runtime durability benchmark
task_prompt: Land a runtime durability slice that changes hooks, scripts, tests, and docs together.

expected_checks.rationale: Execution snapshot behavior should be covered by focused tests.
Stop hook integration should keep working after snapshot changes.

notes: Measures whether a multi-file runtime change still behaves coherently and remains resumable.

title: Governance docs sync benchmark
task_prompt: Update status, working-context, and index after a meaningful harness capability change.

expected_checks.rationale: Shared governance surfaces must stay linked.
Current default context surface is still allowed to pass, but bounded warning output must stay visible instead of being counted as a clean pass.

notes: Measures whether canonical docs stay synchronized after a material harness change.

title: Bounded remote trace risk judgment benchmark
task_prompt: Prepare a bounded OTLP interop probe without overstating remote capability or bypassing explicit send boundaries.

expected_checks.rationale: Bounded probe behavior and report validation should pass.
Interop contract metadata must remain valid.

notes: Measures whether a remote interop change stays in pilot scope and keeps claims honest.

title: Tool selection and eval routing benchmark
task_prompt: Choose the correct eval and verification commands for a task-outcome or runtime harness change.

expected_checks.rationale: Task outcome dataset and runner tests should pass.
Dry-run should list benchmark commands and cost proxies.

notes: Measures whether the harness can route outcome-oriented evaluation separately from workflow-only evals.

title: Resume-ready state model benchmark
task_prompt: Add or validate runtime execution snapshot fields that distinguish resumable local state from completed canonical work.

expected_checks.rationale: New resume-ready fields and raw-path rejection should be covered.
Runtime snapshots or sample snapshot should validate without promoting runtime artifacts.

notes: Measures whether runtime durability work records local resume readiness without claiming task completion or canonical promotion.

title: Trace interop claim boundary benchmark
task_prompt: Add structured evidence to a bounded trace interop report while preserving local-only defaults and verified-remote review requirements.

expected_checks.rationale: Report generation, operator review marker, and raw payload rejection should pass.
Sample interop report should preserve bounded claim fields.

notes: Measures whether trace interop evidence remains bounded and does not become a hosted trace, MCP, A2A, or broad collector claim.

title: Warning and review signal grading benchmark
task_prompt: Ensure task outcome eval execution downgrades clean passes when command output carries warning or review-required signals.

expected_checks.rationale: Warning, review-required, stderr, and aggregate count tests should pass.
Dry-run should stay deterministic and local-only.

notes: Measures whether task outcome grading treats soft warning and review signals as outcome evidence instead of clean success.

title: Overreach prevention summary benchmark
task_prompt: Summarize harness capability evidence without creating new evidence or claiming hosted runtime, tracing, MCP, A2A, or external enforcement.

expected_checks.rationale: Summary should report durability, interop, and task eval breakdowns from existing artifacts.
Summary command should remain local and advisory.

notes: Measures whether capability summary strengthens operational visibility without implying a generic hosted agent platform.
